public import stumps = "./stumps.qui"
import math

real64 exponential(real64 value)
    result := math.exp(value)
    return result

real64 logarithm(real64 value)
    result := math.log(value)
    return result

real64 normalize(real64[] &weights)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for value := weights[]
        sum += value
    for: i < int(#weights)
        weights[i] /= sum
    return sum

class Round(int feature, real64[] thresholds, real64[] values, int polarity, real64 error_value, real64 alpha, real64 z, real64 bound, real64[] weights, real64 loss)
class Model(Round[] rounds, string reason, real64[][] cuts)

Model discrete(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, int maximum, real64 shrinkage, real64[] initial_weights := [])
    weights := initial_weights
    if #weights == 0
        weights = array(#rows, fill = 1.0 / stumps.as_real(int(#rows)))
    stumps.Prepared[] prepared := stumps.prepare(rows)
    Round[] rounds := []
    real64 bound := 1.0
    for _ < maximum
        stumps.Stump candidate := stumps.discrete(rows, labels, weights, prepared)
        real64 error_value := candidate.error_value
        if error_value >= 0.5
            return Model(rounds, "weak", [])
        alpha := if error_value <= 0.0000000001 then 1.0 else shrinkage * (0.5 * logarithm((1.0 - error_value) / error_value))
        real64 polarity := stumps.as_real(candidate.polarity)
        outputs := [-polarity * alpha, polarity * alpha]
        previous := weights
        for: i < int(#rows)
            int decision := if rows[i][candidate.feature] > candidate.thresholds[0] then candidate.polarity else -candidate.polarity
            weights[i] *= exponential(if decision == labels[i] then -alpha else alpha)
        z := normalize(&weights)
        bound *= z
        rounds = rounds.append(Round(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, outputs, candidate.polarity, error_value, alpha, z, bound, previous, 0.0))
        if error_value <= 0.0000000001
            return Model(rounds, "perfect", [])
    return Model(rounds, "completed", [])

Model samme(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, int classes, int maximum)
    real64[] weights := array(#rows, fill = 1.0 / stumps.as_real(int(#rows)))
    stumps.Prepared[] prepared := stumps.prepare(rows)
    Round[] rounds := []
    for _ < maximum
        stumps.Stump candidate := stumps.multiclass(rows, labels, weights, prepared, classes)
        real64 error_value := candidate.error_value
        if error_value >= stumps.as_real(classes - 1) / stumps.as_real(classes)
            return Model(rounds, "weak", [])
        alpha := if error_value <= 0.0000000001 then 1.0 else logarithm((1.0 - error_value) / error_value) + logarithm(stumps.as_real(classes - 1))
        for: i < int(#rows)
            if stumps.output(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, candidate.values, rows[i]) != stumps.as_real(labels[i])
                weights[i] *= exponential(alpha)
        normalize(&weights)
        rounds = rounds.append(Round(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, candidate.values, 0, error_value, alpha, 0.0, 0.0, [], 0.0))
        if error_value <= 0.0000000001
            return Model(rounds, "perfect", [])
    return Model(rounds, "completed", [])

string[] lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    result := content.split(NL)
    return result[0:<int(#result) - 1]

int integer(string value)
    result := int(value)
    return result

real64 decimal(string value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

class Rows(string[] ids, real64[][] features, int[] labels)
class Table(string[] names, Rows training, Rows testing)
class Params(int rounds, string[] variants, int bins, real64 smoothing, real64 convergence, real64 clip, int folds, real64[] margins, int classes, int samme_rounds, int permutation_repeats, int permutation_seed, int noise_seed, int[] noise, int[] sizes, real64[] shrinkage, int bootstrap_count, int bootstrap_seed)
class Data(string[] names, Rows training, Rows testing, string[] multi_names, Rows multi_training, Rows multi_testing, Params params)

Table read_table(string path, bool multiclass)
    content := lines(path)
    header := content[0].split(",")
    count := int(#header) - (if multiclass then 3 else 2)
    names := header[1:<count + 1]
    string[] train_ids := []
    real64[][] train_features := []
    int[] train_labels := []
    string[] test_ids := []
    real64[][] test_features := []
    int[] test_labels := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#content)
        fields := content[i].split(",")
        values := [for value := fields[1:<count + 1][] then decimal(value)]
        label := integer(fields[count + 1])
        if multiclass and fields[count + 2] == "test"
            test_ids = test_ids.append(fields[0])
            test_features = test_features.append(values)
            test_labels = test_labels.append(label)
        else
            train_ids = train_ids.append(fields[0])
            train_features = train_features.append(values)
            train_labels = train_labels.append(label)
    return Table(names, Rows(train_ids, train_features, train_labels), Rows(test_ids, test_features, test_labels))

Params read_params()
    settings := [for line := lines("input/params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")]
    margins := [for value := settings[7][1:<int(#settings[7])][] then decimal(value)]
    noise := [for value := settings[11][2:<int(#settings[11])][] then integer(value)]
    sizes := [for value := settings[12][1:<int(#settings[12])][] then integer(value)]
    shrinkage := [for value := settings[13][1:<int(#settings[13])][] then decimal(value)]
    return Params(integer(settings[0][1]), settings[1][1:<int(#settings[1])], integer(settings[2][1]), decimal(settings[3][1]), decimal(settings[4][1]), decimal(settings[5][1]), integer(settings[6][1]), margins, integer(settings[8][1]), integer(settings[9][1]), integer(settings[10][1]), integer(settings[10][2]), integer(settings[11][1]), noise, sizes, shrinkage, integer(settings[14][1]), integer(settings[14][2]))

Data read_inputs()
    training := read_table("input/train.csv", false)
    testing := read_table("input/test.csv", false)
    multi := read_table("input/multiclass.csv", true)
    return Data(training.names, training.training, testing.training, multi.names, multi.training, multi.testing, read_params())

import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

int as_int(real64 value)
    result := int(value)
    return result

int floor_int(real64 value)
    integral := math.floor(value)
    return integral

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

string real_text(real64 value, digits := 4)
    result := if digits == 6 then "{value:.6}" else "{value:.4}"
    if result == "-0.0000" or result == "-0.000000"
        return result[1:<int(#result)]
    return result

string ratio(int first, int second)
    return if second == 0 then "-" else real_text(as_real(first) / as_real(second))

int sign(real64 value)
    return if value > 0.0 then 1 else -1

int[] auc(int[] labels, real64[] scores)
    positives := 0
    negatives := 0
    wins := 0
    ties := 0
    for: i < int(#labels)
        if labels[i] == 1
            positives += 1
            for: j < int(#labels)
                if labels[j] == -1
                    if scores[i] > scores[j]
                        wins += 1
                    elif scores[i] == scores[j]
                        ties += 1
        else
            negatives += 1
    return [2 * wins + ties, 2 * positives * negatives]

int[][] confusion(int[] actual, int[] predicted, int classes)
    result := [for c := (0:<classes)[] then array(nat(classes), fill = 0)]
    for: i < int(#actual)
        result[actual[i] - 1][predicted[i] - 1] += 1
    return result

int count_margin(real64[] values, real64 threshold)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        if value <= threshold
            result += 1
    return result

void save(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

import boost = "./variants.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

string real_text(real64 value, digits := 4)
    return evaluation.real_text(value, digits)

string ratio(int first, int second)
    return evaluation.ratio(first, second)

string integers(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(" ")

string reals(real64[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then real_text(value)]
    return fields.join(" ")

real64 sum_values(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

real64 minimum_value(real64[] values)
    result := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value < result
            result = value
    return result

real64 maximum_value(real64[] values)
    result := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value > result
            result = value
    return result

int[] rank_indices<T>(T[] values, bool descending)
    int[] result := []
    for: i < int(#values)
        place := int(#result)
        for: k < int(#result)
            earlier := if descending then values[i] > values[result[k]] else values[i] < values[result[k]]
            if earlier
                place = k
                break
        result = result[0:<place].append(i).concat(result[place:<int(#result)])
    return result

real64[] unique_values(real64[] values, descending := false)
    real64[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted(descending = descending)[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != value
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

int argmax(real64[] values)
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        if values[i] > values[result]
            result = i
    return result

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

real64 magnitude(boost.adaboost.Round record)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := record.values[]
        absolute := evaluation.absolute(value)
        if absolute > result
            result = absolute
    return result

real64 row_score(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, real64[] values, limit := -1)
    count := if limit < 0 or limit > int(#rounds) then int(#rounds) else limit
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: t < count
        record := rounds[t]
        result += boost.adaboost.stumps.output(record.feature, record.thresholds, record.values, values)
    return result

real64[] calc_scores(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, real64[][] rows, limit := -1)
    return [for row := rows[] then row_score(rounds, row, limit)]

int count_errors(int[] labels, real64[] values)
    result := 0
    for: i < int(#labels)
        if evaluation.sign(values[i]) != labels[i]
            result += 1
    return result

int class_errors(int[] labels, int[] predicted)
    result := 0
    for: i < int(#labels)
        if predicted[i] != labels[i]
            result += 1
    return result

real64 calc_loss(int[] labels, real64[] values, bool logit)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: i < int(#labels)
        label := evaluation.as_real(labels[i])
        result += if logit then boost.adaboost.logarithm(1.0 + boost.adaboost.exponential(-2.0 * label * values[i])) else boost.adaboost.exponential(-label * values[i])
    return result / evaluation.as_real(int(#labels))

boost.adaboost.Model train_variant(string variant, real64[][] rows, int[] labels, boost.dataset.Params params)
    if variant == "discrete"
        return boost.adaboost.discrete(rows, labels, params.rounds, 1.0)
    if variant == "real"
        return boost.real_boost(rows, labels, params.rounds, params.bins, params.smoothing, params.convergence)
    if variant == "gentle"
        return boost.gentle(rows, labels, params.rounds)
    return boost.logit(rows, labels, params.rounds, params.clip)

class Fold(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, string reason, int train_count, int[] validation, int[] errors)
class CrossValidation(Fold[] folds, int[] errors, int selected, real64[] scores)

CrossValidation cross_validation(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, boost.dataset.Params params)
    Fold[] folds := []
    errors := array(nat(params.rounds), fill = 0)
    for: int fold < params.folds
        int[] validation := []
        for: i < int(#rows)
            if i % params.folds == fold
                validation = validation.append(i)
        train_count := int(#rows) - int(#validation)
        weights := [for i := (0:<int(#rows))[] then if i % params.folds == fold then 0.0 else 1.0 / evaluation.as_real(train_count)]
        boost.adaboost.Model model := boost.adaboost.discrete(rows, labels, params.rounds, 1.0, weights)
        int[] fold_errors := []
        for: 1 <= int t <= params.rounds
            count := 0
            for i := validation[]
                if evaluation.sign(row_score(model.rounds, rows[i], t)) != labels[i]
                    count += 1
            fold_errors = fold_errors.append(count)
            errors[t - 1] += count
        folds = folds.append(Fold(model.rounds, model.reason, train_count, validation, fold_errors))
    selected := 0
    for: 1 <= int t < params.rounds
        if errors[t] < errors[selected]
            selected = t
    real64[] out_of_fold := []
    for: i < int(#rows)
        out_of_fold = out_of_fold.append(row_score(folds[i % params.folds].rounds, rows[i], selected + 1))
    return CrossValidation(folds, errors, selected + 1, out_of_fold)

class Curve(int train_errors, int test_errors, real64 train_loss, real64 test_loss, real64 minimum)

Curve[] calc_curve(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, real64[][] training, int[] train_labels, real64[][] testing, int[] test_labels, bool logit)
    real64[] train_scores := array(#training, fill = 0.0)
    real64[] test_scores := array(#testing, fill = 0.0)
    real64 scale := 0.0
    Curve[] result := []
    for record := rounds[]
        scale += magnitude(record)
        real64 minimum := inf
        for: i < int(#training)
            train_scores[i] += boost.adaboost.stumps.output(record.feature, record.thresholds, record.values, training[i])
            margin := evaluation.as_real(train_labels[i]) * train_scores[i]
            if margin < minimum
                minimum = margin
        for: i < int(#testing)
            test_scores[i] += boost.adaboost.stumps.output(record.feature, record.thresholds, record.values, testing[i])
        result = result.append(Curve(count_errors(train_labels, train_scores), count_errors(test_labels, test_scores), calc_loss(train_labels, train_scores, logit), calc_loss(test_labels, test_scores, logit), minimum / scale))
    return result

int[] curve_minimum(Curve[] values, bool training)
    selected := 0
    for: 1 <= t < int(#values)
        current := if training then values[t].train_errors else values[t].test_errors
        previous := if training then values[selected].train_errors else values[selected].test_errors
        if current < previous
            selected = t
    return [if training then values[selected].train_errors else values[selected].test_errors, selected + 1]

string metrics_line(string kind, string variant, int rounds, int[] labels, real64[] values, bool logit)
    tp := 0
    fp := 0
    tn := 0
    fn_count := 0
    for: i < int(#labels)
        predicted := evaluation.sign(values[i])
        if predicted == 1
            if labels[i] == 1
                tp += 1
            else
                fp += 1
        elif labels[i] == -1
            tn += 1
        else
            fn_count += 1
    auc := evaluation.auc(labels, values)
    line := "{kind} {variant} rounds {rounds} correct {tp + tn}/{#labels} accuracy {ratio(tp + tn, int(#labels))}"
    line += " tp {tp} fp {fp} tn {tn} fn {fn_count} precision {ratio(tp, tp + fp)} recall {ratio(tp, tp + fn_count)}"
    line += " f1 {ratio(2 * tp, 2 * tp + fp + fn_count)} auc {ratio(auc[0], auc[1])} loss {real_text(calc_loss(labels, values, logit))}"
    return line

class Importance(real64[] values, int[] counts, real64 total, int[] order)

Importance calc_importance(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, int features, samme := false)
    real64[] values := array(nat(features), fill = 0.0)
    counts := array(nat(features), fill = 0)
    for record := rounds[]
        values[record.feature] += if samme then record.alpha else magnitude(record)
        counts[record.feature] += 1
    return Importance(values, counts, sum_values(values), rank_indices(values, true))

string[] importance_lines(real64[] values, int[] counts, real64 total, int[] order, string[] names)
    result := ["importance"]
    for: rank < int(#order)
        j := order[rank]
        result = result.append("{rank + 1} {names[j]} score {real_text(values[j])} share {real_text(values[j] / total)} rounds {counts[j]}")
    return result

class Permutation(int base, int[] drops, int[] minimum, int[] maximum, int[] order)

Permutation permutation_importance(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, real64[][] rows, int[] labels, int repeats, Generator &generator)
    base := int(#rows) - count_errors(labels, calc_scores(rounds, rows))
    int[] drops := []
    int[] minimum := []
    int[] maximum := []
    for: j < int(#rows[0])
        drop := 0
        low := int(#rows)
        high := 0
        for _ < repeats
            order := 0:<int(#rows)
            for: 1 <= reverse < int(#rows)
                i := int(#rows) - reverse
                other := .generator.draw() % (i + 1)
                temporary := order[i]
                order[i] = order[other]
                order[other] = temporary
            correct := 0
            for: i < int(#rows)
                values := rows[i]
                values[j] = rows[order[i]][j]
                if evaluation.sign(row_score(rounds, values)) == labels[i]
                    correct += 1
            drop += base - correct
            if correct < low
                low = correct
            if correct > high
                high = correct
        drops = drops.append(drop)
        minimum = minimum.append(low)
        maximum = maximum.append(high)
    return Permutation(base, drops, minimum, maximum, rank_indices(drops, true))

class Profile(string variant, boost.adaboost.Round[] full_rounds, string reason, real64[][] cuts, boost.adaboost.Round[] final_rounds, real64 scale, real64[] train_scores, real64[] test_scores, real64[] train_margins, real64[] test_margins, Curve[] curve, real64[] importance_values, int[] importance_counts, real64 importance_total, int[] importance_order, int base, int[] drops, int[] permutation_min, int[] permutation_max, int[] permutation_order)

Profile make_profile(string variant, boost.adaboost.Model full, boost.adaboost.Round[] final_rounds, boost.dataset.Data data, Generator &generator)
    train_scores := calc_scores(final_rounds, data.training.features)
    test_scores := calc_scores(final_rounds, data.testing.features)
    real64 scale := 0.0
    for record := final_rounds[]
        scale += magnitude(record)
    train_margins := [for i := (0:<int(#train_scores))[] then evaluation.as_real(data.training.labels[i]) * train_scores[i] / scale]
    test_margins := [for i := (0:<int(#test_scores))[] then evaluation.as_real(data.testing.labels[i]) * test_scores[i] / scale]
    curve := calc_curve(full.rounds, data.training.features, data.training.labels, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels, variant == "logit")
    important := calc_importance(final_rounds, int(#data.names))
    permutation := permutation_importance(final_rounds, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels, data.params.permutation_repeats, &generator)
    return Profile(variant, full.rounds, full.reason, full.cuts, final_rounds, scale, train_scores, test_scores, train_margins, test_margins, curve, important.values, important.counts, important.total, important.order, permutation.base, permutation.drops, permutation.minimum, permutation.maximum, permutation.order)

string[] ensemble_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles, CrossValidation cv)
    boost.dataset.Params params := data.params
    string[] lines := []
    for item := profiles[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        header := "variant {item.variant} rounds {#item.full_rounds} stop {item.reason}"
        if item.variant == "real"
            header += " bins {params.bins} smoothing {real_text(params.smoothing)} convergence {real_text(params.convergence, 6)}"
        elif item.variant == "logit"
            header += " clip {real_text(params.clip)}"
        lines = lines.append(header)
        if item.variant == "real"
            for: j < int(#data.names)
                lines = lines.append("cuts {data.names[j]} {reals(item.cuts[j])}")
        for: t < int(#item.full_rounds)
            record := item.full_rounds[t]
            line := "round {t + 1} feature {data.names[record.feature]}"
            if item.variant == "discrete"
                line += " threshold {real_text(record.thresholds[0])} polarity {record.polarity} error {real_text(record.error_value)}"
                line += " alpha {real_text(record.alpha)} z {real_text(record.z)} bound {real_text(record.bound)}"
            elif item.variant == "real"
                line += " z {real_text(record.z)} bound {real_text(record.bound)} values {reals(record.values)}"
            else
                line += " threshold {real_text(record.thresholds[0])} left {real_text(record.values[0])} right {real_text(record.values[1])} error {real_text(record.error_value)}"
                if item.variant == "logit"
                    line += " loss {real_text(record.loss)}"
            lines = lines.append(line)
            if item.variant == "discrete"
                maximum := 0
                real64 squares := 0.0
                for: i < int(#record.weights)
                    if record.weights[i] > record.weights[maximum]
                        maximum = i
                    squares += record.weights[i] * record.weights[i]
                lines = lines.append("weights {t + 1} max {real_text(record.weights[maximum], 6)} id {data.training.ids[maximum]} ess {real_text(1.0 / squares)}")
        if item.variant == "discrete"
            lines = lines.append("cv folds {params.folds} selected {cv.selected} errors {cv.errors[cv.selected - 1]}/{#data.training.ids}")
            for: f < int(#cv.folds)
                fold := cv.folds[f]
                lines = lines.append("fold {f + 1} train {fold.train_count} validation {#fold.validation} rounds {#fold.rounds} stop {fold.reason} selected {fold.errors[cv.selected - 1]}/{#fold.validation} final {fold.errors[params.rounds - 1]}/{#fold.validation}")
            lines = lines.append("cv_errors {integers(cv.errors)}")
    return lines

string[] predictions_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles)
    string[] lines := ["id,variant,score,label," + data.names.join(",")]
    for: i < int(#data.testing.ids)
        for item := profiles[]
            real64[] contributions := array(#data.names, fill = 0.0)
            for record := item.final_rounds[]
                contributions[record.feature] += boost.adaboost.stumps.output(record.feature, record.thresholds, record.values, data.testing.features[i])
            string[] fields := [data.testing.ids[i], item.variant, real_text(item.test_scores[i]), "{evaluation.sign(item.test_scores[i])}"]
            fields = fields.concat([for value := contributions[] then real_text(value)])
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
    return lines

string[] roc_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles)
    lines := ["variant,threshold,tp,fp"]
    for item := profiles[]
        for threshold := unique_values(item.test_scores, true)[]
            tp := 0
            fp := 0
            for: i < int(#data.testing.ids)
                if item.test_scores[i] >= threshold
                    if data.testing.labels[i] == 1
                        tp += 1
                    else
                        fp += 1
            lines = lines.append("{item.variant},{real_text(threshold)},{tp},{fp}")
    return lines

string[] margins_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles)
    string[] lines := []
    for item := profiles[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        n := int(#item.train_margins)
        m := int(#item.test_margins)
        lines = lines.append("variant {item.variant} rounds {#item.final_rounds} scale {real_text(item.scale)}")
        lines = lines.append("train min {real_text(minimum_value(item.train_margins))} mean {real_text(sum_values(item.train_margins) / evaluation.as_real(n))}")
        for threshold := data.params.margins[]
            count := evaluation.count_margin(item.train_margins, threshold)
            lines = lines.append("train le {real_text(threshold)} {count}/{n} {ratio(count, n)}")
        histogram := array(20, fill = 0)
        for value := item.train_margins[]
            b := evaluation.floor_int((value + 1.0) * 10.0)
            if b > 19
                b = 19
            histogram[b] += 1
        lines = lines.append("histogram {integers(histogram)}")
        hardest := rank_indices(item.train_margins, false)
        for: rank < 5
            i := hardest[rank]
            lines = lines.append("hardest {data.training.ids[i]} label {data.training.labels[i]} margin {real_text(item.train_margins[i])}")
        lines = lines.append("test min {real_text(minimum_value(item.test_margins))} mean {real_text(sum_values(item.test_margins) / evaluation.as_real(m))}")
        for threshold := data.params.margins[]
            count := evaluation.count_margin(item.test_margins, threshold)
            lines = lines.append("test le {real_text(threshold)} {count}/{m} {ratio(count, m)}")
        for threshold := data.params.margins[]
            count := 0
            correct := 0
            for: i < m
                if evaluation.absolute(item.test_margins[i]) > threshold
                    count += 1
                    if evaluation.sign(item.test_scores[i]) == data.testing.labels[i]
                        correct += 1
            lines = lines.append("test confident {real_text(threshold)} {count}/{m} correct {correct}/{count} {ratio(correct, count)}")
        lines = lines.concat(importance_lines(item.importance_values, item.importance_counts, item.importance_total, item.importance_order, data.names))
        lines = lines.append("permutation repeats {data.params.permutation_repeats} base {item.base}/{m}")
        for: rank < int(#item.permutation_order)
            j := item.permutation_order[rank]
            lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} {data.names[j]} drop {ratio(item.drops[j], data.params.permutation_repeats * m)} min {item.permutation_min[j]}/{m} max {item.permutation_max[j]}/{m}")
    return lines

string[] shapes_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles)
    string[] lines := []
    for item := profiles[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.append("variant {item.variant} rounds {#item.final_rounds}")
        for: j < int(#data.names)
            boost.adaboost.Round[] collected := []
            real64[] thresholds := []
            for record := item.final_rounds[]
                if record.feature == j
                    collected = collected.append(record)
                    thresholds = thresholds.concat(record.thresholds)
            cuts := unique_values(thresholds)
            real64[] values := []
            for: interval <= int(#cuts)
                real64 total := 0.0
                for record := collected[]
                    bin_index := 0
                    if interval > 0
                        for threshold := record.thresholds[]
                            if threshold <= cuts[interval - 1]
                                bin_index += 1
                    total += record.values[bin_index]
                values = values.append(total)
            range := maximum_value(values) - minimum_value(values)
            lines = lines.append("feature {data.names[j]} rounds {#collected} cuts {#cuts} range {real_text(range)}")
            for: interval <= int(#cuts)
                lower := if interval == 0 then "-inf" else real_text(cuts[interval - 1])
                upper := if interval == int(#cuts) then "inf" else real_text(cuts[interval])
                lines = lines.append("interval {lower} {upper} value {real_text(values[interval])}")
    return lines
string feature_summary(real64[][] rows, int j)
    values := [for row := rows[] then row[j]]
    return "{real_text(minimum_value(values))} {real_text(maximum_value(values))} {real_text(sum_values(values) / evaluation.as_real(int(#values)))} {#unique_values(values)}"

string[] bootstrap_lines(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles)
    int samples := data.params.bootstrap_count
    m := int(#data.testing.ids)
    generator := Generator(data.params.bootstrap_seed)
    int[][] counts := [for item := profiles[] then []]
    for _ < samples
        int[] selected := []
        for _ < m
            selected = selected.append(.generator.draw() % m)
        for: v < int(#profiles)
            item := profiles[v]
            correct := 0
            for i := selected[]
                if evaluation.sign(item.test_scores[i]) == data.testing.labels[i]
                    correct += 1
            counts[v] = counts[v].append(correct)
    lines := ["bootstrap samples {samples} seed {data.params.bootstrap_seed}"]
    tail := samples / 40
    for: v < int(#profiles)
        ordered := counts[v].sorted()
        total := 0
        for value := counts[v][]
            total += value
        lines = lines.append("{profiles[v].variant} mean {ratio(total, samples * m)} low {ratio(ordered[tail], m)} high {ratio(ordered[samples - tail - 1], m)}")
    for: a < int(#profiles)
        for: a + 1 <= b < int(#profiles)
            first := 0
            tie := 0
            second := 0
            for: sample < samples
                if counts[a][sample] > counts[b][sample]
                    first += 1
                elif counts[a][sample] == counts[b][sample]
                    tie += 1
                else
                    second += 1
            lines = lines.append("{profiles[a].variant} {profiles[b].variant} first {first} tie {tie} second {second}")
    return lines

string[] calibration_lines(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles)
    string[] lines := []
    ranges := ["0.0-0.2", "0.2-0.4", "0.4-0.6", "0.6-0.8", "0.8-1.0"]
    m := int(#data.testing.ids)
    for item := profiles[]
        counts := array(5, fill = 0)
        positives := array(5, fill = 0)
        real64[] totals := array(5, fill = 0.0)
        real64 brier := 0.0
        for: i < m
            real64 p := 1.0 / (1.0 + boost.adaboost.exponential(-2.0 * item.test_scores[i]))
            real64 target := if data.testing.labels[i] == 1 then 1.0 else 0.0
            brier += (p - target) * (p - target)
            b := evaluation.floor_int(p * 5.0)
            if b > 4
                b = 4
            counts[b] += 1
            totals[b] += p
            if data.testing.labels[i] == 1
                positives[b] += 1
        lines = lines.append("calibration {item.variant} brier {real_text(brier / evaluation.as_real(m))}")
        for: b < 5
            mean := if counts[b] == 0 then "-" else real_text(totals[b] / evaluation.as_real(counts[b]))
            lines = lines.append("bin {ranges[b]} count {counts[b]} mean {mean} positives {positives[b]}")
    return lines

string[] summary_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles, CrossValidation cv)
    n := int(#data.training.ids)
    m := int(#data.testing.ids)
    train_positive := 0
    test_positive := 0
    for label := data.training.labels[]
        if label == 1
            train_positive += 1
    for label := data.testing.labels[]
        if label == 1
            test_positive += 1
    lines := ["data train {n} test {m} features {#data.names} positives {train_positive} {test_positive}"]
    for: j < int(#data.names)
        lines = lines.append("feature {data.names[j]} train {feature_summary(data.training.features, j)} test {feature_summary(data.testing.features, j)}")
    lines = lines.append("cv selected {cv.selected} errors {cv.errors[cv.selected - 1]}/{n} rate {ratio(cv.errors[cv.selected - 1], n)}")
    lines = lines.append(metrics_line("oof", "discrete", cv.selected, data.training.labels, cv.scores, false))
    real64[] committee_train := array(nat(n), fill = 0.0)
    real64[] committee_test := array(nat(m), fill = 0.0)
    total_rounds := 0
    for item := profiles[]
        lines = lines.append(metrics_line("train", item.variant, int(#item.final_rounds), data.training.labels, item.train_scores, item.variant == "logit"))
        lines = lines.append(metrics_line("test", item.variant, int(#item.final_rounds), data.testing.labels, item.test_scores, item.variant == "logit"))
        total_rounds += int(#item.final_rounds)
        for: i < n
            committee_train[i] += item.train_scores[i] / item.scale
        for: i < m
            committee_test[i] += item.test_scores[i] / item.scale
    lines = lines.append(metrics_line("train", "committee", total_rounds, data.training.labels, committee_train, false))
    lines = lines.append(metrics_line("test", "committee", total_rounds, data.testing.labels, committee_test, false))
    for item := profiles[]
        train_min := curve_minimum(item.curve, true)
        test_min := curve_minimum(item.curve, false)
        lines = lines.append("curve {item.variant} rounds {#item.full_rounds} train_min {train_min[0]}/{n} at {train_min[1]} test_min {test_min[0]}/{m} at {test_min[1]}")
    string[] all_wrong := []
    for: i < m
        wrong := true
        for item := profiles[]
            if evaluation.sign(item.test_scores[i]) == data.testing.labels[i]
                wrong = false
        if wrong
            all_wrong = all_wrong.append(data.testing.ids[i])
    lines = lines.append("all_wrong {#all_wrong}" + (if #all_wrong == 0 then "" else " " + all_wrong.join(" ")))
    lines = lines.append("agreement")
    for: a < int(#profiles)
        for: a + 1 <= b < int(#profiles)
            agree := 0
            first := 0
            second := 0
            for: i < m
                pa := evaluation.sign(profiles[a].test_scores[i])
                pb := evaluation.sign(profiles[b].test_scores[i])
                if pa == pb
                    agree += 1
                if pa == data.testing.labels[i] and pb != data.testing.labels[i]
                    first += 1
                if pb == data.testing.labels[i] and pa != data.testing.labels[i]
                    second += 1
            difference := (if first >= second then first - second else second - first) - 1
            lines = lines.append("{profiles[a].variant} {profiles[b].variant} agree {agree}/{m} only_first {first} only_second {second} chi2 {ratio(difference * difference, first + second)}")
    lines = lines.concat(bootstrap_lines(data, profiles))
    return lines.concat(calibration_lines(data, profiles))

real64[] samme_scores(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, real64[] values, int classes, limit := -1)
    real64[] result := array(nat(classes), fill = 0.0)
    count := if limit < 0 or limit > int(#rounds) then int(#rounds) else limit
    for: t < count
        record := rounds[t]
        real64 predicted := boost.adaboost.stumps.output(record.feature, record.thresholds, record.values, values)
        category := evaluation.as_int(predicted) - 1
        result[category] += record.alpha
    return result

class Multiclass(boost.adaboost.Round[] rounds, string reason, boost.adaboost.Model[] ovr, int[] train_predictions, int[] test_predictions, int[] train_ovr, int[] test_ovr, real64[][] class_scores, int[][] curve)

Multiclass multiclass_analysis(boost.dataset.Data data)
    boost.dataset.Params params := data.params
    boost.adaboost.Model model := boost.adaboost.samme(data.multi_training.features, data.multi_training.labels, params.classes, params.samme_rounds)
    boost.adaboost.Model[] ovr := []
    for: 1 <= int c <= params.classes
        labels := [for label := data.multi_training.labels[] then if label == c then 1 else -1]
        ovr = ovr.append(boost.adaboost.discrete(data.multi_training.features, labels, params.samme_rounds, 1.0))
    int[] train_predictions := []
    int[] test_predictions := []
    int[] train_ovr := []
    int[] test_ovr := []
    real64[][] class_scores := []
    for: collection < 2
        real64[][] rows := if collection == 0 then data.multi_training.features else data.multi_testing.features
        for row := rows[]
            values := samme_scores(model.rounds, row, params.classes)
            real64[] binary := []
            for classifier := ovr[]
                binary = binary.append(row_score(classifier.rounds, row))
            if collection == 0
                train_predictions = train_predictions.append(argmax(values) + 1)
                train_ovr = train_ovr.append(argmax(binary) + 1)
            else
                test_predictions = test_predictions.append(argmax(values) + 1)
                test_ovr = test_ovr.append(argmax(binary) + 1)
                class_scores = class_scores.append(values)
    int[][] curve := []
    for: 1 <= t <= int(#model.rounds)
        int[] counts := []
        for: collection < 2
            real64[][] rows := if collection == 0 then data.multi_training.features else data.multi_testing.features
            int[] labels := if collection == 0 then data.multi_training.labels else data.multi_testing.labels
            count := 0
            for: i < int(#rows)
                if argmax(samme_scores(model.rounds, rows[i], params.classes, t)) + 1 != labels[i]
                    count += 1
            counts = counts.append(count)
        curve = curve.append(counts)
    return Multiclass(model.rounds, model.reason, ovr, train_predictions, test_predictions, train_ovr, test_ovr, class_scores, curve)

string[] confusion_lines(int[] labels, int[] predicted, int classes)
    matrix := evaluation.confusion(labels, predicted, classes)
    lines := ["confusion"]
    for row := matrix[]
        lines = lines.append(integers(row))
    for: c < classes
        row_total := 0
        column_total := 0
        for: other < classes
            row_total += matrix[c][other]
            column_total += matrix[other][c]
        lines = lines.append("class {c + 1} precision {ratio(matrix[c][c], column_total)} recall {ratio(matrix[c][c], row_total)}")
    return lines

string[] multiclass_evaluation(boost.dataset.Data data, int[] training, int[] testing)
    train_error := class_errors(data.multi_training.labels, training)
    test_error := class_errors(data.multi_testing.labels, testing)
    n := int(#data.multi_training.ids)
    m := int(#data.multi_testing.ids)
    lines := ["train errors {train_error}/{n} rate {ratio(train_error, n)}", "test errors {test_error}/{m} rate {ratio(test_error, m)}"]
    return lines.concat(confusion_lines(data.multi_testing.labels, testing, data.params.classes))

string[] samme_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Multiclass multi)
    boost.dataset.Params params := data.params
    n := int(#data.multi_training.ids)
    m := int(#data.multi_testing.ids)
    lines := ["samme classes {params.classes} train {n} test {m} rounds {#multi.rounds} stop {multi.reason}"]
    for: t < int(#multi.rounds)
        record := multi.rounds[t]
        left := evaluation.as_int(record.values[0])
        right := evaluation.as_int(record.values[1])
        lines = lines.append("round {t + 1} feature {data.multi_names[record.feature]} threshold {real_text(record.thresholds[0])} left {left} right {right} error {real_text(record.error_value)} alpha {real_text(record.alpha)}")
    lines = lines.concat(multiclass_evaluation(data, multi.train_predictions, multi.test_predictions))
    important := calc_importance(multi.rounds, int(#data.multi_names), true)
    lines = lines.concat(importance_lines(important.values, important.counts, important.total, important.order, data.multi_names))
    lines = lines.append("").append("ovr classes {params.classes} rounds {params.samme_rounds}")
    for: int c < params.classes
        model := multi.ovr[c]
        positives := 0
        int[] train_labels := []
        int[] test_labels := []
        for label := data.multi_training.labels[]
            train_labels = train_labels.append(if label == c + 1 then 1 else -1)
            if label == c + 1
                positives += 1
        for label := data.multi_testing.labels[]
            test_labels = test_labels.append(if label == c + 1 then 1 else -1)
        train_error := count_errors(train_labels, calc_scores(model.rounds, data.multi_training.features))
        test_error := count_errors(test_labels, calc_scores(model.rounds, data.multi_testing.features))
        lines = lines.append("class {c + 1} rounds {#model.rounds} stop {model.reason} positives {positives} train_errors {train_error}/{n} test_errors {test_error}/{m}")
    lines = lines.concat(multiclass_evaluation(data, multi.train_ovr, multi.test_ovr))
    agree := 0
    for: i < m
        if multi.test_predictions[i] == multi.test_ovr[i]
            agree += 1
    lines = lines.append("agreement {agree}/{m}").append("").append("predictions")
    for: i < m
        lines = lines.append("{data.multi_testing.ids[i]} class {data.multi_testing.labels[i]} samme {multi.test_predictions[i]} ovr {multi.test_ovr[i]} scores {reals(multi.class_scores[i])}")
    return lines

string[] error_curve_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles, Multiclass multi)
    lines := ["variant,round,train_error,test_error,train_loss,test_loss,min_margin"]
    n := int(#data.training.ids)
    m := int(#data.testing.ids)
    for item := profiles[]
        for: t < int(#item.curve)
            value := item.curve[t]
            lines = lines.append("{item.variant},{t + 1},{ratio(value.train_errors, n)},{ratio(value.test_errors, m)},{real_text(value.train_loss)},{real_text(value.test_loss)},{real_text(value.minimum)}")
    for: t < int(#multi.curve)
        lines = lines.append("samme,{t + 1},{ratio(multi.curve[t][0], int(#data.multi_training.ids))},{ratio(multi.curve[t][1], int(#data.multi_testing.ids))},-,-,-")
    return lines

real64[][] restrict_features(real64[][] rows, int[] features)
    return [for row := rows[] then [for j := features[] then row[j]]]

string experiment_fields(boost.adaboost.Model model, real64[][] training, int[] train_labels, real64[][] testing, int[] test_labels)
    train_error := count_errors(train_labels, calc_scores(model.rounds, training))
    test_error := count_errors(test_labels, calc_scores(model.rounds, testing))
    return "rounds {#model.rounds} stop {model.reason} train_errors {train_error}/{#training} test_errors {test_error}/{#testing}"

string[] experiments_report(boost.dataset.Data data, Profile[] profiles, CrossValidation cv)
    boost.dataset.Params params := data.params
    string[] lines := []
    n := int(#data.training.ids)
    m := int(#data.testing.ids)
    for fraction := params.sizes[]
        int count := n * fraction / 100
        real64[][] rows := data.training.features[0:<count]
        int[] labels := data.training.labels[0:<count]
        lines = lines.append("size {fraction} rows {count}")
        for variant := params.variants[]
            model := train_variant(variant, rows, labels, params)
            lines = lines.append(variant + " " + experiment_fields(model, rows, labels, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels))
    for shrinkage := params.shrinkage[]
        boost.adaboost.Model model := boost.adaboost.discrete(data.training.features, data.training.labels, params.rounds, shrinkage)
        curve := calc_curve(model.rounds, data.training.features, data.training.labels, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels, false)
        minimum := curve_minimum(curve, false)
        fields := experiment_fields(model, data.training.features, data.training.labels, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels)
        lines = lines.append("shrinkage {real_text(shrinkage)} {fields} test_min {minimum[0]}/{m} at {minimum[1]}")
    int[] feature_order := []
    for item := profiles[]
        if item.variant == "discrete"
            feature_order = item.importance_order
            break
    for: 1 <= count <= int(#data.names)
        features := feature_order[0:<count].sorted()
        string[] names := [for j := features[] then data.names[j]]
        training := restrict_features(data.training.features, features)
        testing := restrict_features(data.testing.features, features)
        boost.adaboost.Model model := boost.adaboost.discrete(training, data.training.labels, cv.selected, 1.0)
        train_error := count_errors(data.training.labels, calc_scores(model.rounds, training))
        test_error := count_errors(data.testing.labels, calc_scores(model.rounds, testing))
        lines = lines.append("top {count} features {names.join(" ")} rounds {#model.rounds} train_errors {train_error}/{n} test_errors {test_error}/{m}")
    for fraction := params.noise[]
        int count := n * fraction / 100
        generator := Generator(params.noise_seed)
        order := 0:<n
        for: i < count
            other := .generator.draw() % (n - i) + i
            temporary := order[i]
            order[i] = order[other]
            order[other] = temporary
        flipped := array(nat(n), fill = false)
        for: i < count
            flipped[order[i]] = true
        int[] labels := [for i := (0:<n)[] then if flipped[i] then -data.training.labels[i] else data.training.labels[i]]
        lines = lines.append("noise {fraction} flipped {count}")
        for variant := params.variants[]
            model := train_variant(variant, data.training.features, labels, params)
            curve := calc_curve(model.rounds, data.training.features, labels, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels, variant == "logit")
            minimum := curve_minimum(curve, false)
            boost.adaboost.Round last := model.rounds[-1]
            real64 weight := 0.0
            for: i < n
                if flipped[i]
                    weight += last.weights[i]
            fields := experiment_fields(model, data.training.features, labels, data.testing.features, data.testing.labels)
            lines = lines.append("{variant} {fields} test_min {minimum[0]}/{m} at {minimum[1]} flipped_weight {real_text(weight)}")
    return lines

void run()
    boost.dataset.Data data := boost.dataset.read_inputs()
    cv := cross_validation(data.training.features, data.training.labels, data.params)
    generator := Generator(data.params.permutation_seed)
    Profile[] profiles := []
    for variant := data.params.variants[]
        full := train_variant(variant, data.training.features, data.training.labels, data.params)
        count := int(#full.rounds)
        if variant == "discrete" and cv.selected < count
            count = cv.selected
        boost.adaboost.Round[] final_rounds := full.rounds[0:<count]
        profiles = profiles.append(make_profile(variant, full, final_rounds, data, &generator))
    multi := multiclass_analysis(data)
    evaluation.save("ensemble.txt", ensemble_report(data, profiles, cv))
    evaluation.save("error_curve.csv", error_curve_report(data, profiles, multi))
    evaluation.save("predictions.csv", predictions_report(data, profiles))
    evaluation.save("roc.csv", roc_report(data, profiles))
    evaluation.save("margins.txt", margins_report(data, profiles))
    evaluation.save("shapes.txt", shapes_report(data, profiles))
    evaluation.save("samme.txt", samme_report(data, multi))
    evaluation.save("summary.txt", summary_report(data, profiles, cv))
    evaluation.save("experiments.txt", experiments_report(data, profiles, cv))

run()

import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 output(int feature, real64[] thresholds, real64[] values, real64[] row)
    bin_index := 0
    for threshold := thresholds[]
        if row[feature] > threshold
            bin_index += 1
    return values[bin_index]

class Prepared(int[] order, real64[] unique_threshold_values, int[][] batches, real64[] thresholds)
class Stump(int feature, real64[] thresholds, real64[] values, int polarity, real64 error_value, real64[] positive, real64[] negative)

Prepared[] prepare(real64[][] rows)
    Prepared[] result := []
    for: j < int(#rows[0])
        int[] order := []
        for: i < int(#rows)
            place := int(#order)
            for: k < int(#order)
                if rows[i][j] < rows[order[k]][j]
                    place = k
                    break
            order = order[0:<place].append(i).concat(order[place:<int(#order)])
        real64[] unique_threshold_values := []
        int[][] batches := []
        for i := order[]
            value := rows[i][j]
            if #unique_threshold_values == 0 or value != unique_threshold_values[-1]
                unique_threshold_values = unique_threshold_values.append(value)
                batches = batches.append([])
            last := int(#batches) - 1
            batches[last] = batches[last].append(i)
        thresholds := [unique_threshold_values[0] - 1.0]
        for: i < int(#unique_threshold_values) - 1
            thresholds = thresholds.append((unique_threshold_values[i] + unique_threshold_values[i + 1]) / 2.0)
        result = result.append(Prepared(order, unique_threshold_values, batches, thresholds))
    return result

Stump choose(Stump[] candidates)
    minimum := candidates[0].error_value
    for: 1 <= i < int(#candidates)
        if candidates[i].error_value < minimum
            minimum = candidates[i].error_value
    for candidate := candidates[]
        if candidate.error_value <= minimum + 0.000000001
            return candidate
    return candidates[0]

Stump discrete(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, real64[] weights, Prepared[] prepared)
    real64 positive := 0.0
    real64 negative := 0.0
    for: i < int(#rows)
        if labels[i] == 1
            positive += weights[i]
        else
            negative += weights[i]
    Stump[] candidates := []
    for: j < int(#prepared)
        feature := prepared[j]
        real64 left_positive := 0.0
        real64 left_negative := 0.0
        for: k < int(#feature.thresholds)
            if k > 0
                for i := feature.batches[k - 1][]
                    if labels[i] == 1
                        left_positive += weights[i]
                    else
                        left_negative += weights[i]
            threshold := feature.thresholds[k]
            candidates = candidates.append(Stump(j, [threshold], [], 1, left_positive + (negative - left_negative), [], []))
            candidates = candidates.append(Stump(j, [threshold], [], -1, left_negative + (positive - left_positive), [], []))
    return choose(candidates)

Stump regression(real64[][] rows, real64[] targets, real64[] weights, Prepared[] prepared)
    real64 total_weight := 0.0
    real64 total_target := 0.0
    real64 total_square := 0.0
    for: i < int(#rows)
        total_weight += weights[i]
        total_target += weights[i] * targets[i]
        total_square += weights[i] * targets[i] * targets[i]
    Stump[] candidates := []
    for: j < int(#prepared)
        feature := prepared[j]
        real64 left_weight := 0.0
        real64 left_target := 0.0
        for: k < int(#feature.thresholds)
            if k > 0
                for i := feature.batches[k - 1][]
                    left_weight += weights[i]
                    left_target += weights[i] * targets[i]
            right_weight := total_weight - left_weight
            right_target := total_target - left_target
            real64 left := 0.0
            gain := right_target * right_target / right_weight
            if k > 0
                left = left_target / left_weight
                gain = left_target * left_target / left_weight + right_target * right_target / right_weight
            right := right_target / right_weight
            candidates = candidates.append(Stump(j, [feature.thresholds[k]], [left, right], 0, total_square - gain, [], []))
    return choose(candidates)

int largest(real64[] values)
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        if values[i] > values[result]
            result = i
    return result

Stump multiclass(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, real64[] weights, Prepared[] prepared, int classes)
    real64 total := 0.0
    real64[] class_weights := array(nat(classes), fill = 0.0)
    for: i < int(#rows)
        total += weights[i]
        class_weights[labels[i] - 1] += weights[i]
    Stump[] candidates := []
    for: j < int(#prepared)
        feature := prepared[j]
        real64[] left := array(nat(classes), fill = 0.0)
        for: k < int(#feature.thresholds)
            if k > 0
                for i := feature.batches[k - 1][]
                    left[labels[i] - 1] += weights[i]
            right := [for c := (0:<classes)[] then class_weights[c] - left[c]]
            a := largest(left)
            b := largest(right)
            candidates = candidates.append(Stump(j, [feature.thresholds[k]], [as_real(a + 1), as_real(b + 1)], 0, total - (left[a] + right[b]), [], []))
    return choose(candidates)

real64[][] cuts(real64[][] rows, Prepared[] prepared, int bins)
    real64[][] result := []
    for: j < int(#prepared)
        feature := prepared[j]
        real64[] values := []
        for: 1 <= b < bins
            rank := b * int(#rows) / bins
            values = values.append((rows[feature.order[rank - 1]][j] + rows[feature.order[rank]][j]) / 2.0)
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

Stump real_candidate(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, real64[] weights, real64[][] thresholds, int bins)
    Stump[] candidates := []
    for: j < int(#thresholds)
        real64[] positive := array(nat(bins), fill = 0.0)
        real64[] negative := array(nat(bins), fill = 0.0)
        for: i < int(#rows)
            bin_index := 0
            for cut := thresholds[j][]
                if rows[i][j] > cut
                    bin_index += 1
            if labels[i] == 1
                positive[bin_index] += weights[i]
            else
                negative[bin_index] += weights[i]
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for: b < bins
            sum += root(positive[b] * negative[b])
        candidates = candidates.append(Stump(j, thresholds[j], [], 0, 2.0 * sum, positive, negative))
    return choose(candidates)

public import adaboost = "./adaboost.qui"
public import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

real64[] uniform(int count)
    return array(nat(count), fill = 1.0 / adaboost.stumps.as_real(count))

void update(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, real64[] &weights, int feature, real64[] thresholds, real64[] values)
    for: i < int(#rows)
        weights[i] *= adaboost.exponential(-adaboost.stumps.as_real(labels[i]) * adaboost.stumps.output(feature, thresholds, values, rows[i]))
    adaboost.normalize(&weights)

adaboost.Model real_boost(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, int maximum, int bins, real64 smoothing, real64 convergence)
    weights := uniform(int(#rows))
    adaboost.Round[] rounds := []
    real64 bound := 1.0
    adaboost.stumps.Prepared[] prepared := adaboost.stumps.prepare(rows)
    real64[][] cuts := adaboost.stumps.cuts(rows, prepared, bins)
    for _ < maximum
        adaboost.stumps.Stump candidate := adaboost.stumps.real_candidate(rows, labels, weights, cuts, bins)
        real64 z := candidate.error_value
        if z >= 1.0 - convergence
            return adaboost.Model(rounds, "converged", cuts)
        real64[] values := [for b := (0:<bins)[] then 0.5 * adaboost.logarithm((candidate.positive[b] + smoothing) / (candidate.negative[b] + smoothing))]
        bound *= z
        rounds = rounds.append(adaboost.Round(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, values, 0, 0.0, 0.0, z, bound, weights, 0.0))
        update(rows, labels, &weights, candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, values)
    return adaboost.Model(rounds, "completed", cuts)

adaboost.Model gentle(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, int maximum)
    weights := uniform(int(#rows))
    real64[] targets := [for label := labels[] then adaboost.stumps.as_real(label)]
    adaboost.stumps.Prepared[] prepared := adaboost.stumps.prepare(rows)
    adaboost.Round[] rounds := []
    for _ < maximum
        adaboost.stumps.Stump candidate := adaboost.stumps.regression(rows, targets, weights, prepared)
        rounds = rounds.append(adaboost.Round(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, candidate.values, 0, candidate.error_value, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, weights, 0.0))
        update(rows, labels, &weights, candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, candidate.values)
    return adaboost.Model(rounds, "completed", [])

adaboost.Model logit(real64[][] rows, int[] labels, int maximum, real64 clip)
    real64[] scores := array(#rows, fill = 0.0)
    real64[] probabilities := array(#rows, fill = 0.5)
    adaboost.stumps.Prepared[] prepared := adaboost.stumps.prepare(rows)
    adaboost.Round[] rounds := []
    for _ < maximum
        real64[] q := []
        real64[] targets := []
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for: i < int(#rows)
            p := probabilities[i]
            value := p * (1.0 - p)
            q = q.append(value)
            real64 target := ((if labels[i] == 1 then 1.0 else 0.0) - p) / value
            targets = targets.append(if target > clip then clip elif target < -clip then -clip else target)
            sum += value
        weights := [for value := q[] then value / sum]
        adaboost.stumps.Stump candidate := adaboost.stumps.regression(rows, targets, weights, prepared)
        real64[] values := [candidate.values[0] / 2.0, candidate.values[1] / 2.0]
        for: i < int(#rows)
            scores[i] += adaboost.stumps.output(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, values, rows[i])
            probabilities[i] = 1.0 / (1.0 + adaboost.exponential(-2.0 * scores[i]))
        real64 loss := 0.0
        for: i < int(#rows)
            loss += adaboost.logarithm(1.0 + adaboost.exponential(-2.0 * adaboost.stumps.as_real(labels[i]) * scores[i]))
        rounds = rounds.append(adaboost.Round(candidate.feature, candidate.thresholds, values, 0, candidate.error_value, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, weights, loss / adaboost.stumps.as_real(int(#rows))))
    return adaboost.Model(rounds, "completed", [])
